snippet.title: Danganronpa: Grand Lie [Full Playthrough - No Commentary]
snippet.description:
Six Ultimates wake up in a Hotel, 
a crime and sin, they all have brought.
Shall they go mad in these cells?
For the only way out is to kill and not get caught.

Danganronpa: Grand Lie is a Fangan for the #FangansForHope game jam all made in a month. No knowledge of mainline Danganronpa games is needed. Completely original story and characters.

Play it here: collectorsincorporated.itch.io/dr-grand-lie

The Game Takes place in the 1920s.

Directed, illustrated, written, and programmed by: bidel
